description: This file defines the DirectoryEntryAdapter class, which provides RecyclerView adapter functionality for displaying directory entries, including listing filenames and icons based on MIME types.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter to display directory entries, handling view creation, data binding, and item count.

classes.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: Inner class holding references to UI components for each directory entry item.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with an empty list of directory entries.

methods.name: DirectoryEntryAdapter(List<DirectoryEntry>)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a list of directory entries to display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the directory entry layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds directory entry data to the view holder, setting filename, MIME type, and icon.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of directory entries.

methods.name: setDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Updates the list of directory entries displayed by the adapter.
